book.palaneogenesis.category.transformat: The Ancient form and everything it changes.
Ancestral guardian. He only fights hostile mobs.

Káak Tun is an ancestral guardian of the ancient villages, from an age when a civilization tied to magic still lived. He reflects that people.$(br2)He walks the villages again because a new era began: $(item)Palaneogénesis$().

Palaneogénesis is the era where ancient power and a power from the future, one that does not exist yet, converge.$(br2)Káak Tun is strong and wise. He never attacks the player, even if struck: in his eyes, Steve is a god.
Give Káak Tun $(item)4 Lapis Lazuli$() and he hands you a $(l:items/hearts/blue_heart)Blue Heart$().$(br2)Defeating him also drops one, but he never fights back.
Health: 300 (150 hearts)$(br)Armor: 20$(br)Armor toughness: 8$(br)Speed: 0.20$(br)Knockback resist.: 0.4$(br)Follow range: 24$(br)Size: 2.93 x 3.30 blocks
Melee: 60 dmg, range 3, 1 s between hits.$(br)Beam: 45 dmg, range 12, 2 s charge (40 ticks).$(br)Targets: hostile mobs only.$(br)Spawns: near villages, 1 per village by default.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.mobs.kaak_tun_: A standard spawn egg for $(l:mobs/kaak_tun)Káak Tun$(), available only in Creative mode.$(br2)It has no crafting recipe: it exists to place a guardian directly, instead of waiting for one to appear near a village.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.items.syringes: The base of the syringes. On its own it does nothing, but it is the main ingredient of the $(l:items/syringes/ancient_extract_syringe)Ancient Extract Syringe$().$(br2)Used while transformed, it reverts the transformation and breaks into a $(l:items/syringes/broken_syringe)Broken Syringe$().

Reverting: max health back to 20 (less any $(l:transformations/empty_hearts)penalty$()).$(br)Health fully restored.$(br)Speed and attack bonus removed.$(br)Consumes 1 syringe.$(br)Does nothing if not transformed.

Starts the $(l:transformations/ancestral_transformation)Ancient transformation$(). Using it injects the extract and turns Steve into his ancient form.$(br2)It leaves an $(l:items/syringes/empty_syringe)Empty Syringe$() behind, needed to revert later.
Any order. Water can be a Water Bucket or a Water Bottle.
Max health: 1 (half a heart).$(br)Temporary life: 40 points (20 hearts).$(br)Speed: +30%.$(br)Attack damage: +5.$(br)Slowdown: -90% for 3.5 s.$(br)Cannot be used while transformed.

A shattered syringe, left behind when an $(l:items/syringes/empty_syringe)Empty Syringe$() reverts the transformation.$(br2)It is a tool for a transformation that does not exist yet. For now, using it does nothing.
Crafting: none.$(br)Obtained: reverting with an Empty Syringe.$(br)Stacks normally.$(br)Use: nothing (reserved for a future transformation).
book.palaneogenesis.entry.items.hearts.b: The Blue Heart belongs to Káak Tun and is the only item tied directly to him. It is the basic heart: no special effect, but the base of every other heart.

Use it while transformed to gain 1 point of blue life, which absorbs 1 point of damage.$(br2)It is also the base to craft the other three hearts and the $(l:items/syringes/ancient_extract_syringe)Ancient Extract Syringe$().
No crafting recipe.$(br2)Give 4 Lapis Lazuli to $(l:mobs/kaak_tun)Káak Tun$(): he returns 1 Blue Heart.
Points per use: 1 (half a heart).$(br)Usable only while transformed.$(br)Gives: blue life only.$(br)Source: Káak Tun (4 Lapis Lazuli) or his drop.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.items.hearts.e: Brave people whose hearts beat so hard and so endlessly that they adapted to nature. A wise Creeper, moved by their spark, taught them what he knew.$(br2)It is the passion for what burns bright and ends anytime, yet leaves a great impact.
When an Explosive Heart point breaks, it explodes around you.$(br2)Every hostile mob within 5 blocks dies. The explosion never damages blocks.
Points per use: 1 (half a heart).$(br)Usable only while transformed.$(br)Radius: 5 blocks (11x11x11).$(br)Affects: hostile mobs.$(br)Block damage: none.$(br)Recipe yield: 2.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.items.hearts.i: Ancestral power was always used by noble people. But one squad of the old army had corrupted hearts and could no longer use it fully, so they learned the arts of the Nether and the End.$(br2)The Inverted Heart is born from that fusion.
The strongest heart. When an Inverted Heart point breaks, every hostile mob within 49.5 blocks takes 500 magic damage.$(br2)Only the Ender Dragon is spared: she is a boss, too powerful for it.
Makes 2 hearts. Wither Skeleton Skull or Wither Rose on each side.

Points per use: 1 (half a heart).$(br)Usable only while transformed.$(br)Radius: 49.5 blocks (100x100x100).$(br)Damage: 500 (magic).$(br)Affects: hostile mobs, not the Ender Dragon.$(br)Recipe yield: 2.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.items.hearts.r: The warriors trained for years, passed trials and left families behind. Through all that, they grew strong.$(br2)So this heart is not only named Resistance: $(item)this heart was the resistance$().
While you hold them, you get Haste: 2 points = Haste I, 4 = Haste II, 6 or more = Haste III (the maximum).$(br2)Breaking a point lowers the level and gives Resistance II for 3 s.
Points per use: 1 (half a heart).$(br)Usable only while transformed.$(br)Haste: 2 pts I, 4 pts II, 6+ pts III.$(br)On break: Resistance II, 3 s (60 ticks).$(br)Recipe yield: 2.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.transformation: Born from fusing Steve's blood with the blood of Káak Tun, the ancestral guardian.$(br2)Inject the $(l:items/syringes/ancient_extract_syringe)Ancient Extract Syringe$() to take the Ancient form.

At first the fusion slows Steve down while his heart pounds hard with the power sinking in.$(br2)Once the blood has fused, the real transformation begins: Steve is faster, more agile and can resist more.

Powers: $(l:transformations/kaak_beam)Káak Tun's beam$() and $(l:transformations/mega_jump)mega jump$().$(br2)Cost: health no longer regenerates, see $(l:transformations/heart_system)Hearts system$(). Abuse is punished: $(l:transformations/empty_hearts)Empty Hearts$().
Max health: 1 (half a heart).$(br)Blue life: 40 points.$(br)Speed: +30%.$(br)Attack damage: +5 (fist hits for 6).$(br)Start slowdown: -90% for 70 ticks (3.5 s).$(br)Revert: use an Empty Syringe.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.ancestral.name: Ancestral Transformation
book.palaneogenesis.entry.transformation: Steve loses his regenerating max health. His life now works per hit, and his hearts turn blue.$(br2)In exchange, he can use four kinds of hearts: $(l:items/hearts/blue_heart)Blue$(), $(l:items/hearts/explosive_heart)Explosive$(), $(l:items/hearts/inverted_heart)Inverted$() and $(l:items/hearts/resistance_heart)Resistance$().

Heart management: each point absorbs 1 point of damage, so strong enemies break several. Armor still lowers the hit first.$(br2)Crafted hearts break first (newest first), then the syringe's life. With none left, the next hit kills.
Syringe life: 40 points.$(br)Each heart item: 1 point.$(br)2 points = 1 full heart icon.$(br)Hearts are inert while not transformed (they are kept).$(br)All hearts are cleared on death.
Steve carries the power of Káak Tun inside: a beam.$(br2)While transformed, hold the Fire Beam key (H by default) with a target in range. After a short charge it fires and damages the target.
Charge: 40 ticks (2 s).$(br)Damage: 18.$(br)Range: 30 blocks.$(br)Key: H (can be changed in Controls).$(br)Only while transformed.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.kaak_beam.name: Káak Tun's Beam
book.palaneogenesis.entry.transformation: While transformed, jump and keep holding the Jump key in the air: Steve shoots upward.$(br2)The flight ends at its maximum height and then needs time to recharge. No fall damage after it.
Hold time: 5 ticks.$(br)Max height: 5 blocks.$(br)Cooldown: 10 s (200 ticks).$(br)Fall damage: none after the flight.$(br)Only while transformed.
book.palaneogenesis.entry.mega_jump.name: Mega Jump
book.palaneogenesis.entry.transformation: The transformation has a risk. Transforming and reverting many times in a row creates empty hearts: a punishment of power.$(br2)It cuts Steve's max health both visually and for real: with 10 hearts drawn, he might truly have 8.

Trigger: 5 toggles in a row, each within 5 s of the last.$(br)Transforming and reverting both count.$(br)Penalty: 2 hearts of max health.$(br)Minimum max health: 1 heart.$(br)Repair: all return after 2 min without a new penalty.
advancement.palaneogenesis.has_blue_hear: Obtain a Blue Heart. Unlocks more pages in the Book of Palaneogénesis.
advancement.palaneogenesis.has_ancient_s: Obtain an Ancient Extract Syringe. Unlocks the transformation pages.
